input_hash_scope: Hashes describe baseline commit and frozen inputs as read. The report generator is subsequently changed only to preserve appendices; its prior hash is verifiable with git show baseline_commit:path.

findings.shared_ar: slot26: active && axi_iommu_tr_req.ar_valid && axi_iommu_tr_resp.ar_ready, merged pretranslation DMA TR input; all ports, no A-DID filter.
findings.shared_ar_wait: slot28: active && same TR ARVALID && !ARREADY; blocked cycles, not completed transactions or DS cycles.
findings.a_ar: slot20: active && private axi_dma_tr[aggressor].ARVALID && ARREADY before mux; not S1 misses or DS PTE reads.
findings.a_aw: slot21: active && private axi_dma_tr[aggressor].AWVALID && AWREADY before mux; not PTE writes.
findings.path: Stage0 private first AR/AW VALID -> merged TR handshake; stage1 -> COMP first VALID; stage2 -> COMP handshake; stage3 -> COMP RLAST/B; per-role reconstructed mux AXI ID, no DS connection.
findings.window: Opening first V issue edge is excluded from active increments; final V done edge is included: (e_issue,e_final_done]. Opening/closing occupancy snapshots include same-edge events (count_next/reads_n/writes_n).
findings.axi_s: No literal axi_s signal is an observer input in these frozen modules. Top-level common crossbar integration is via slave[IOMMU_COMP] and separate slave[IOMMU_MEM]; observer sees only the local signals explicitly listed.

minimal_future_a_s1_start.event: Export a single-cycle actual walk-admission pulse with en_1S and !implicit tag, associated with stable req_data.did; do not count level ptw_init each cycle.
minimal_future_a_s1_start.possible_exact_source: PTW state_q==IDLE && init_ptw_i && !edge_trigger_q && en_1S_i && !imp_init_i; latch/propagate req_data.did at the associated TL admission.
minimal_future_a_s1_start.role: Current workload owner DID is11 (port1); compare actual 24-bit walk owner DID, not DS ARID0. General selected A role is ARM-latched explicit DID.
minimal_future_a_s1_start.inflight_boundary_flags: Track current A S1 walk owner/in-flight state continuously across ARM/open/close, snapshot opening/end after same-edge accepted-start/completion. Never reset the pulse edge tracker on ARM/open; only clear the window result counter.
minimal_future_a_s1_start.window: Increment only when existing observer active is true to preserve (e_issue,e_final_done]; clear on ARM; freeze after closing edge; latch for readout; sticky overflow/error and versioned register schema.
minimal_future_a_s1_start.HPM_boundary: Accepted-start cycle and HPM registered increment cycle are different candidate event definitions; select/document one and preserve its pipeline delay at window boundaries.
minimal_future_a_s1_start.validation_needed: A future new BIT plus event/role/boundary calibration would be needed; no implementation, build or board run is authorized/performed by this audit.

evidence.claim: active is HARDWARE/POLL_WAIT/REFILL, never ARMED or BATCH_READ.
Private outstanding tracking runs continuously, including outside measurement.
At first V issue while ARMED, change next state and capture post-edge outstanding; no active counts yet.
After final done, software final poll is a separate BATCH_READ phase and counter34.
A/private and shared handshakes use VALID&&READY; waits count VALID&&!READY cycles.
Final V done is still active, then transitions to BATCH_READ and captures post-edge outstanding.
Complete path input list contains only these five event-chain points, not DS/PTW.

evidence.claim: Four stages join five events: private first-valid, shared TR handshake, COMP first-valid, COMP handshake, final return.
First-valid detection suppresses repeated stalled VALID; it is not a handshake count.
Opening/closing occupancy uses count_next after simultaneous enter/leave.
Born-in-window uses active; active enters/leaves accumulate counts and whole/carry classification.
Path queue runs from ARM through close; close stops after the closing edge.
Printed a_ar/a_aw map slots20/21; shared_ar/shared_ar_wait map26/28; path output fields map entered/full/carry/sum/max/start/end/area.

evidence.claim: Candidate PTW init is a level held during PT miss, not a pulse.
Stable translation request DID is available inside TL; currently used for HPM filtering.
S1 event marking depends on en_1S; not every PTW request is S1.
PTW suppresses repeated init with its edge-trigger state.
Actual walk admission is IDLE and init&&!edge; implicit path is a distinct tag.

limits: No candidate direct measurement of in-window DS AR or A S1-start exists among these observer fields.
Shared TR wait and path internal time may include translation/data/controller queuing but do not identify S1 start time or DS bus ownership.

Even a future generic DS_AR counter mixes DDTW/PDTW/CQ/PQ/MSIPTW/MRIF; window boundaries can contain only part of a three-PTE walk, so DS_AR/3 is not N_Astart. PTW filtering and retained DID are needed for any optional per-A PTE cross-check.
This source audit does not upgrade prior HPM software snapshots to atomic hardware-window measurements.
